## Parsing API Data

```{r}
helper <- function(year = 2024, vars = c(), restrictions = c()) {

  #Generate all the input parameters:
  address <- "https://api.census.gov/data/"
  
  #Check singularity and validity of the year
  if (length(year) != 1) {
    stop("Argument 'year' must be a single value, not a vector or list.")
  }
  if (!year %in% c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)) {
    stop("Argument 'year' must be ONE of the following: 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024.")
  }
browser()
  #Check the requested variables
  if (length(vars) == 0) {
    final_request_vars <- "AGEP,PWGTP,SEX"
  } else if (length(vars) != 0) {
    vars_allowed = c("AGEP", "GASP", "GRPIP", "JWAP", "JWDP", "JWMNP", "JWMNP", "PWGTP","FER","HHL","SCH","SCHL","SEX","ST","STATE","REGION","DIVISION")
    rlang::arg_match(vars_allowed, multiple = TRUE)
    stop("Dudeski, you chose variables that are not in our list. Please restrict to numeric variables: AGEP, GASP, GRPIP, JWAP, JWDP, JWMNP, and to categorical varailes: FER, HHL, SCH, SCHL, SEX.")
  }
  else {
    #Create separate lists of geographical, string, and numeric variables for further checking
    numeric_vars <- c("AGEP", "GASP", "GRPIP", "JWAP", "JWDP", "JWMNP", "JWMNP")
    string_vars  <- c("FER","HHL","SCH","SCHL","SEX")
    geography_vars<- c("ST","STATE","REGION","DIVISION")
    
    #Rename variable "ST" to "STATE" for years 2021 & 2022

    
    #Create separate lists of the requested variables for each type
     req_num_vars <- vars[vars %in% numeric_vars]
     req_str_vars <- vars[vars %in% string_vars]
     req_geo_vars <- vars[vars %in% geography_vars]
     
     #Push out defaults, in case nothing is listed
     if (length(req_num_vars) == 0) req_num_vars <- "AGEP"
     if (length(req_str_vars) == 0) req_str_vars <- "SEX"
     if (length(req_geo_vars) == 0) req_geo_vars <- "STATE"
     
     #Glue the strings all together
     final_request_vars <- paste0(req_num_vars,req_str_vars,req_geo_vars,"PWGTP")
  }
  
  #Call API and parse result
  final_api <- paste0(address,year,"/acs/acs1/pums?get=",final_request_vars, "&key=541a25ef175ec8d1abf1a4b9bb864ac88cf70e54")

  variable_json <- httr::GET(final_api)
  parsed <- fromJSON(rawToChar(variable_json$content))

  #Make API result into tibble, save it, and display it in the log
  api_result <- parsed |>
    janitor::row_to_names(row_number = 1) |>
    as_tibble()|>
    type_convert()
  View(api_result)
  return(api_result)
}

yr2020x<- helper(year = 2020)  #Should fail, year out of range.
yr2024b<- helper()
yr2021 <- helper(vars=c("AGEP", "SEX"))  #Should still work
yr2021x<- helper(vars=c("AGEP", "BAS"))  #shouldn't work.

yr2024 <- helper(vars = "GASP")
yr2022 <- helper(year = 2022, vars = c("GASP","GRPIP")) 
yr2022b<- helper(year = 2022)

```
